issues.body: The revised header and docstring still call this the `SIXTH` copy and say it is byte-compatible with the `other five` presence-only copies. At this PR head, the same `(alert_repo, alert_token, registry_repo) -> (repo, token|None)` presence-only implementation also exists in `scripts/ledger-identity-watch.py` and `scripts/ratelimit-alert.py`, in addition to the six sites listed in `research/1021-alert-route-consolidation.md` §1. The cited research inventory is therefore stale relative to this checkout, and the equivalent `other five` wording in the other two changed files repeats the same material omission. A consolidation author following this supposedly exhaustive tier description could omit two live trust-plane callers.
issues.fix_hint: State the exhaustive PR-head inventory/count, including `scripts/ledger-identity-watch.py` and `scripts/ratelimit-alert.py`, in all three changed notes and update the cited research record if it is intended to remain authoritative; alternatively, avoid a fixed count and point to a checked/generated inventory that cannot silently become stale.
issues.title: The six-copy presence-only inventory still omits two live implementations

verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-3 major finding remains unresolved. The revised notes still claim a six-copy presence-only tier, but the PR-head tree has eight matching three-argument, two-tuple presence-only implementations: the six listed in the cited research record plus `scripts/ledger-identity-watch.py` and `scripts/ratelimit-alert.py`. Because the same materially misleading inventory remains at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
